terms: impose on one another/make demands on one another
definition: <ki>, one another, with {awhmawh}: apparently be free to burden one another with tasks and bear it; those who can do so, the closer ones, are chosen for the positions of a household; the page does not explain the word

terms: be rivals/be hostile to each other/envy each other
definition: <el>, bear ill will, with the reciprocal prefix <ki>: be rivals or enemies of one another; the book gives it as the opposite of <kilawmta>, be friends
<em>, bake or roast, with the prefix <ki>: be baked; written with a hyphen because two vowels meet
<en>, look, with <ki>, oneself, and <pha>, well: look carefully at one's own conduct

terms: be searched/be looked at again/be re-examined
definition: <et>, look, with the passive prefix <ki> and <kik>, again: be looked at again, said of records that are searched
<ki> with <et>, look, and <teh>, measure: be set beside something and compared with it, with <tawh> for what it is compared with
<etteh>, compare, with <ki>, oneself, and the linking suffix <in>: comparing oneself; <tawh> marks the one compared with
<eu>, hew or prise out, with the passive prefix <ki>; {ki-eu khiat} is be cut out of the rock
<ip>, hold in, with <ki>, oneself, and the linking suffix <in>: holding oneself back, keeping one's anger in
<ip>, hold in, repeated, with <ki>, oneself: keep holding something in, as anger; {ki-ipip zo nawn lo} is can hold back no longer
<ip>, hold in, repeated, with <ki>, oneself, and the noun suffix <na>: holding oneself in again and again, patience with others
{ki-ip}, restrain oneself, with <zo>, be able, and the plural <te>; {kampau a ki-ipzote} are those who can guard their speech
<it>, love, with the reciprocal prefix {ki-}: love one another
<itdan>, way of loving, with the prefix <ki>, written with a hyphen before the vowel: how people love one another
<ki>, one another, with <itna>, love: the love that people have for each other

terms: be fond of each other/love each other
definition: <ki>, one another, with <it>, love, and <pih>, together with: be bound to someone in mutual affection; {ki-itpih deuhte} are those one is fonder of
<uap>, accompany, with the prefix <ki>; written with a hyphen because two vowels meet; the page gives the word alone

terms: stand by one another/attend one another
definition: <uap>, accompany, with the prefix <ki>, one another: come to each other's side and help at times of joy and of mourning
plural with <te> of <ki-uatsakna>, pride or boasting; used beside <kisaktheihna>, pride

terms: be on good terms/be close/get along
definition: <uitui> with the prefix <ki>: be close to one another, be on friendly terms; written with a hyphen because two vowels meet
<uk>, rule, with <ki>, oneself, and <tawm>, by oneself: keep one's own body under control
<um>, surround, with <cip>, tightly, and the passive prefix <ki>; {a ki-umcip} before a noun means enclosed, as a garden, or besieged, as a city
<upmawh>, suspect, with <ki>, each other, the noun suffix <na> and the plural <te>: suspicions that people have of one another
fall down or drop from a height; said of a person, of rain and of seed that falls on the ground; the form <kiat> is used before <leh> and <ciangin>
<kia>, fall, and <ding>, will, written as one word; after <thong>, prison, and a length of time: is to be in prison for that long

terms: to be sentenced to/to serve in prison
definition: <kiading>, will fall, with <in>, written as one word; after <thong>, prison, and a length of time: that one is to be in prison for that long, as the ruling of a court
<kia> and <gawp> written as one word: fall in great quantity or with force, said of snow and hail
a thorny weed that grows on neglected land, usually named together with <ling>, thorn
any wild plant that grows among crops and has to be cleared, and the grass of a lawn that is mown; often {lopa leh kiak}, grass and weeds; not only a thorny thistle
<kia>, fall, with <khawm>, together: fall into something together; {thong a kiakhawm} is to be in prison together with someone
<kia>, fall, with <khia>, out or away: fall off from a person or place
<kia>, fall, with <khin>, already or completely: have fallen off
<kia>, fall, said twice: fall one after another, or go on declining
a time when there is no food in the land, and the hunger it brings; {kial tung} is a famine comes
be in need of food, usually in the phrase {gil kial}, the stomach is hungry
<kial>, be hungry, with the linking suffix <in>; usually {gil kialin}, being or going hungry
<kial>, be hungry, with <lai>, still: be hungry still, even after eating
built on <kial>, hunger: food that stays the hunger, a light meal or the morning meal; {kiallap ne} is eat it
filling a gap for the time being: {kiallap kitelna} is a by-election and {kiallap kumpi} an interim government
coming just when it is needed and meeting the need of the moment; {kiallap mahmah} is very timely
<kial>, be hungry, and <lua>, very or too, written as one word, after <gil>, stomach
<kial>, be hungry, with the noun suffix <na>: the state of being hungry
<kia>, fall, with the negative <lo> written as one word; {lei-ah kialo ding} is will not fall to the ground, said of a hair of the head and of a word that will not fail
<kial>, famine, with <pi>, great: a great famine in a land
<kialpi>, famine, with the plural <te>
<kial>, famine, and <tung>, come, written as one word: famine comes upon a place or people
become less in amount, number or strength; said of flood water that goes down, of a people or herd that grows fewer, and of flesh that wastes away
<kiam>, decrease, with <gawp>, severely: of strength or the body, fail or waste away
<kiam>, decrease, with the linking suffix <in>: dwindling, growing less
<kiam>, decrease, repeated to show that it goes on little by little
<kiam>, decrease, with <kik>, back or again: grow less again, said of wealth quickly gained
<kiam> and <lam> written as one word: the direction of decrease; {kiamlam manawh} is to head toward decline

terms: drop by as much as/go down even
definition: <kiam>, decrease, and <liang>, even, written as one word after an amount: go down by as much as that
a becoming less in amount, number or strength

terms: decrease at once/drop quickly/go down straight away
definition: <kiam>, decrease, and <pah>, at once, written as one word
<kiam>, become less, with the causative <sak>: make less, or let become fewer
<kiam> and <semsem> written as one word: become less and less
<kiam>, go down, with <suk>, downward: sink or subside, as the Nile after its flood
<kiamsuk>, go down, with the noun ending {-na}: a going down in strength, number or standing, the opposite of progress
<kiam> and <ta> written as one word: has become less
<kiam>, decrease, and <thei>, able, written as one word: can or may become less
<kiam>, decrease, with <tuam>, to some degree, written as one word: become noticeably less; {kiamtuam sak} is reduce
<kiamtuam> and the future marker <ding> written as one word: will become less
<kiam>, decrease, with <vat>, suddenly: go down all at once, said of a fever that leaves
<kiam> and <zaw> written as one word: go down further, be less than something else, which stands before it with <sangin>
the place beside or with someone; mostly in <kiangah>, to, and {kiang panin}, from
poetic word for <pasal>, used in songs; the word a wife uses of her husband
<kiang> with the suffix <a>, used where the phrase describes a following noun or verb, as in {pasian kianga thu nget}, praying to God, and {a kianga ding}, standing beside him
<kiang>, presence or side, with the place marker <ah>: to, beside or with a person; it follows the person who is spoken to or approached
<kiangah>, to or beside, run together with <hong>, toward the speaker; elsewhere written as two words, probably a printing error
<kiangah>, to or with a person, and <zong>, also, written as one word after the person named
from a person, from the presence of someone; <kiang> with <pan>, more often written {kiang panin}
from a person or from the presence of someone; <kiangpan> with the suffix <in>
<ki> and <angtanpih> written as one word: the group as a whole is proud of someone or of what was achieved
<ap>, hand over, with the passive prefix <ki>: be entrusted to someone; of a list, be handed in; {sang kiap} is to enrol at a school
<kia>, fall, and <pahpah>, here each one in turn, written as one word: fall or crash again and again, said of aircraft
<kia>, fall, with the causative <sak>: make fall, bring a person down from a high place, or send down hail or birds from the sky
after <thong>, prison: send someone to prison by the judgment of a court; {thong ki kiasak} is be sentenced to prison, often after the length of the term
<kiasak>, send to prison, and <ding>, the marker of what is to come, written as one word; {thong kum 1 sung ki kiasakding} is will be sentenced to one year in prison
<kiasak>, cause to fall, with the linking suffix <in>

terms: can be sentenced to/may be jailed
definition: <kiasak>, cause to fall, and <thei>, can, written as one word; with <thong>, prison, and the passive <ki>: can be sent to prison, as the penalty a law allows
<kia>, fall, with <suk>, downward: fall or come down from a higher place
<kiasuk>, fall down, with the linking suffix <in>
<kiasuk>, fall down, and <kik>, back, written as one word: fall back to the ground after going up, as an aircraft after take-off
<kiasuk>, fall down, with <mawk>, which marks the event as unexpected, written as one word: fall or crash down all at once
<kiasuk>, fall down, with <suak>, right through: fall all the way down from a height or into a hole
form of <kia>, fall, used before <leh>, <ciangin>, <sangin>, <manin> and other endings
used with <lung>, heart: {lung a kiat}, the heart falls, means one is discouraged or grows faint
cut hair off close with a blade, or scrape a surface; {kiat khia} is shave off or scrape away
<kia> and <ta> written as one word: has fallen; said of the sun that has set and of a town taken in war; {lung kiata} is has lost heart
<kiat> and <ding> written as one word: will fall, to fall; {thong kiatding} is the prison term to be served

terms: those that fall/fallen ones/what has fallen
definition: <kia>, fall, with the plural <te>: things that have fallen, as seed, grapes or crumbs
<kia>, fall, and <thei>, can, written as one word: can fall; after <thong> and a length of time it means may be sentenced to prison for that long
<kia>, <thei> and <ding> written as one word: may fall, is liable to fall; <thong kiatheiding> is may be sent to prison
<kiat>, shave or scrape, with the linking suffix <in>; said of shaving the hair and of scraping the walls of a house
<kiat>, scrape, with <khia>, out or away, and the linking suffix <in>: scraping something away
<kiat>, scrape, with <khiat>, off or away; {a kiatkhiat} is what has been scraped off

terms: have shaved off/cause to be shaved off
definition: <kiatkhiat>, shave or scrape off, with the causative <sak>: have something shaved off

terms: fall as a result/end up in
definition: <kiat>, fall, with <lawh>, as a consequence, written as one word: fall or crash because of something; {thong kiatlawh} is end up in prison for it
the act of falling, from <kiat>, fall, with the noun suffix <na>; {za kiatna} is loss of office and {thong kiatna} is being put in prison
in {mul kiatna}, a tool for shaving hair, from <kiat>, shave, with the noun suffix <na>

terms: fall together with/share a fall with
definition: <kiat>, form of <kia>, fall, with <pih>, together with; {thong kiatpih} is to be in prison together with someone, a fellow prisoner
<kiat>, fall, with the causative <sak>: make fall or send down; {thong kiatsak} is put in prison and {za kiatsak} is remove from a position
<kiat>, scrape, with the causative <sak> and the linking suffix <in>: having something scraped
<kiat>, shave, with <siang>, clean: shave away all the hair or beard
<kiat>, fall, with <suah>, let out: let something slip and fall by accident, or of the thing itself, fall off or fall out
<kiat>, fall, and <theih>, be able, written as one word before <nading>: so that one can fall; after <thong> and a length of time, can be sentenced to prison for that long
<kiat>, fall, and <theih>, can, with the noun suffix <na>: the possibility of falling; {kiattheihna ding gum} is a pit that one can fall into
placed after a verb, often before <se> or <hi>, to say that it is only so, or done lightly or in passing; {om kiau se hi} is there is just the one
placed after a verb: it happens off and on or in scattered cases, not steadily

terms: be put on/be laid on/be worn
definition: <baang>, put on, with the passive prefix <ki>: of a yoke, be laid on an animal; of clothing, be put on a person

terms: owe one another/be in debt to one another
definition: <ki>, one another, with <ba>, owe, here written with a long vowel, and <sak>: be left owing each other something, as in Romans 13:8
<bah>, put food to the mouth, with <ki>: feed each other by hand or be given food, as a sign of love; in the saying {Ciimnuai-a sa kibah Geeltui-ah kithuk} a kindness is repaid later
in {a kibaih sa in om}, stand ready beforehand for someone; one other sentence has it as be taken easily or lightly, of marriage and divorce
<bak> with the prefix <ki>: put pieces of meat into each other's mouths at a feast as a sign of affection, in {sa kibak}; see <sabak>

terms: be torn to pieces/be cut in pieces
definition: <balnen>, tear in pieces, with the passive prefix <ki>; often followed by <gawp>, violently

terms: be torn to pieces/be cut in pieces
definition: <kibalnen>, be torn to pieces, with <gawp>, violently
<balzan>, tear apart, with the passive prefix <ki>: said of a person or animal torn by a wild beast

terms: keep up with/catch up with/be equal to
definition: <ban>, reach, with <ki>: come level with others, be their equal; mostly with <zo> and a negative, as in {kiban zo nailo}, not yet able to keep up with
be like; the thing compared with is followed by <tawh>, so that <tawh kibang> means is like
the same, not different; {a kibang} before a noun means the same, as in {ngeina a kibang khat}, one and the same law
something that is like another; {tawh a kibang khat} is one that looks like
<kibang>, same, and <kimlo>, not all: the things named before it are not all the same, they differ from one to another; stands at the end of the clause before <hi> or <ding>

terms: be just the same/be just like/be no different
definition: <kibang>, be alike, and <lel>, here the particle just, merely, not the verb lose: be simply the same; after a noun with <tawh>, be just like it, be no more than it
<kibang>, be alike, with the linking ending <a> before another verb; {tawh kibanga kibawl} means made to be like, as in {ngen tawh kibanga kibawl}, made like a net, the network on the temple pillars

terms: remain the same/stay as it is
definition: <kibang>, be the same, with <bang> repeated: go on being the same, remain as it is

terms: will be like/will be the same
definition: <kibang> and <ding> written as one word, mostly after <tawh>: will be like, will be the same as
<kibang>, be like, and the sentence ending <hi> written as one word: is like, is the same as; the thing compared with takes <tawh>
<kibang>, be alike, with the suffix <in>: alike, equally; after <tawh>, in the same way as
<kibang>, be like, with <kha>, happen to: after <tawh>, may seem to be
<kibang>, same, with <kim>, all: all alike, all the same
<kibang>, be like, with <lai>, still: after <tawh>, still be like
<kibang> and <lel> written as one word: merely the same, no different, mostly after <tawh>
<kibang>, the same, with <lian>, here exactly, written as one word; what it is compared with is followed by <tawh>

terms: not exactly the same/not quite alike
definition: <kibanglian>, exactly the same, and <lo>, not, written as one word: not exactly alike, differing somewhat
<kibang> and <lo> written as one word: not alike, different from each other

<kibang>, alike, with <lote>, those that are not, written as one word: people or things that are not alike; after a noun, those who differ in it, as in {ngaihsutna kibanglote}, those of different views

terms: in the same way/just the same
definition: <kibang> same with the emphatic <mah> and the suffix <in>; another spelling of <kibangmahin>

terms: in the same way/just the same
definition: <kibang> same with the emphatic <mah> and the suffix <in>
<kibang> and <pian.2> written as one word: be about the same as, look like; the thing compared with is followed by <tawh>
<kibang>, be alike, with the causative <sak>: make or treat one as the same as another; <tawh> marks the one compared with
<kibangsak>, make like, with the linking suffix <in>; <tawh> marks the one compared with
<kibang>, be like, with <ta>, marking a state now reached: after <tawh>, have become like

terms: those that are like/those that seem
definition: <kibang>, be like, with the plural <te>: those that are like or seem; it follows <tawh>
<kibang>, be like, with <zaw>, more or rather: after <tawh>, be more like
<kiban>, be equal to, with <pih>, together with: have the same aim, wish or quality as another
<baptaiz>, baptize, a loanword from English, with the passive prefix <ki>: be baptized
<kibaptaiz>, be baptized, with the noun suffix <na>: the baptism that one receives
<kibaptaiz>, be baptized, with the plural <te>

terms: owe one another/be in debt to each other
definition: <ba>, owe, with <ki>, each other, and <sak>: owe one another something
used with <tawh>, with: be like someone or something
with <tawh>: being as another is, or seeming as if something were so
alike, the same as each other; {a kibat kei leh} is if they are not alike
<kibat> and <loh> written as one word: not being alike; {kibatloh hang} is although not the same, and {kibatloh na} is a difference
the fact of not being alike, a difference: <kibat> be alike, <loh> not, with the noun suffix <na>
<kibatlohna>, difference, with the plural <te>: the ways in which people or things are not alike
how one thing is like another, or what two have in common; {tawh a kibatna} is likeness to something
<kibatna>, likeness, with the plural <te>: the ways in which one is like or equal to another, as in {Pasian tawh kibatnate}, equality with God

terms: be like/be alike with/be equal to
definition: <kibat> be like with <pih> together with: be like another; {ka kibatpih ding}, one for me to be like, my equal

<kibatpih> with the plural <te>: those who share the thing named before it, as {biakna kibatpihte}, people of the same religion, {tan kibatpihte}, classmates, and {lungsim kibatpihte}, the like-minded
passive of <bawl>, make or do: be made, prepared or done; with <tawh>, made of or prepared with something
of a sick or injured person: be given medical treatment, at a hospital or with medicine, as in {zatui tawh kibawl}; the one treated is the subject, not a thing that is made
<kibawl> be made with the linking <a>; {kibawla a om}, be in a prepared state
<ki> oneself with <bawl> make, repeated: be making oneself into something
passive use of {kibawlbawl}: a thing is made or prepared, again and again or in various ways, often with <pan> for what it is made from; not making oneself into something

terms: be made in addition/be done further/be added
definition: the prefix <ki> with <bawlbeh> written as one word: more of something is made or done; {thu kibawlbeh} is further action or a further charge is brought
<kibawl>, be done, and <den>, always, written as one word: be done or held again and again, as a custom

terms: will be held/will be done/will be made
definition: <kibawl> and <ding> written as one word: will be held, done or made; <thu kibawlding> is legal action will be taken, and {zatui kibawlding in} is in order to be treated
form of <kibawl>, be made, with the linking suffix <in>: being made, and then going on to what follows
<kibawl>, be made, with <kha>, happen to: be made as it happened, mostly {Record kibawlkha}, be caught on a recording
<kibawl>, be made, with <khia>, out, written as one word: be made and brought out, of goods, models and products
<kibawl>, be made, with <khiat>, out, written as one word: the form of <kibawlkhia> used before words such as <hangin> and <mateng>

terms: have been made/have been done/have been held
definition: <kibawl>, be made or done, and <khin>, already, written as one word: already made, filed, carried out or held
passive <ki> with <bawlkhol>, prepare beforehand: be made ready in advance
<kibawlkhol>, be prepared in advance, with <sa>, already: prepared and waiting

terms: be made again/be redone/be renewed/be held again
definition: <kibawl>, be made or done, and <kik>, again, written as one word: a card is renewed, a report is made again, an event is held again

terms: need to be treated/have to be done
definition: <kibawl>, be treated or be done, and <kul>, be necessary, written as one word; {zatui kibawlkul} is have to receive medical treatment

terms: still be done/be held again/be still under way
definition: <kibawl>, be done or be held, with <lai>, still: it is still being done, or with <ding> it will yet be held
<kibawl>, be made, and <lam>, the fact or way, written as one word: that or how something is made; {a kibawllam i mu hi} is we see that it is made

terms: not be made/not be done/not be held
definition: <kibawl>, be made or done, and <lo>, not, written as one word; {thu kibawllo} is no case is brought, no action is taken

terms: will not be held/will not be done
definition: <kibawllo>, not be done, and <ding>, will, written as one word: will not be held or carried out; {thu kibawlloding} is no case will be brought
noun form of <kibawl>, be made or done: the act, place or means of something being done; {pawi kibawlna inn} is a house where a feast is held
the medical treatment of a disease or of a patient, with <natna>, disease, <zatui>, medicine, or the name of an illness: {kibawlna mun} is a place of treatment; not the making or holding of something

terms: for treatment/for holding/in order to be done
definition: <kibawl>, be done or be treated, and <nading>, for, written as one word: for something to be done or held; after <zatui>, for medical treatment
plural of <kibawlna> in the sense of something being held: the times or occasions on which a feast, jubilee or celebration was held

terms: have been held before/have been done before
definition: <kibawl> and <ngei> written as one word: was once held, made or done

terms: be done at once/be carried out immediately
definition: <kibawl>, be made or done, and <pah>, at once, written as one word: is done, made or given right away, of a report, an operation or treatment
<bawlpha> put right with <ki>, passive or of oneself: mend one's ways under correction, or be made new
form of <kibawlpha> used before <kik>, <hun> and similar words: be put right again, of a broken jar, a ruined city or a person who mends his ways

terms: be done first/be made for now
definition: <kibawl>, be made or done, and <phot>, first or for the time being, written as one word: be done first, be set up or filed for the time being
<kibawl> and <pih> written as one word: be made, done or held for someone or together with someone, as a service, a report or paperwork
<kibawl>, be made, with <sa>, already done: made, prepared or finished beforehand; {a kibawlsa na} is the thing that has been made
<kibawl>, be made, with <sak>: be made or done on behalf of someone, as atonement made for the people

terms: will be held for/will be arranged for
definition: <kibawlsak>, be made or done for someone, and <ding>, will, written as one word: something will be held or arranged for someone

terms: not be made for/not be given treatment
definition: <kibawlsak>, be made or done for someone, and <lo>, not, written as one word: not be made for someone, and of medical treatment, not be given
that by which something is made for someone: <kibawlsak> be made for, with the noun suffix <na>; of the ram with which atonement is made for a person

terms: be planned/be about to be held
definition: <kibawl>, be made or held, with <sawm>, intend, written as one word: something is planned or intended to be done or held
<bawlsia>, mistreat, with the passive <ki>: be treated badly, harmed or persecuted by others
<bawlsia>, mistreat, with <ki> in its sense of each other: hurt or wrong one another
passive of <bawlsiat>; with <hong>, to be persecuted by others
the persecution or torment that people suffer; also of people provoking or harming one another, {khat leh khat kibawlsiatna}

terms: acts of mistreatment/wrongs done to one another
definition: <kibawlsiatna> with plural <te>
<kibawl> with <ta>, which marks that the thing has now happened, written as one word; {thu kibawlta} is a case has been brought, the person has been charged in court

terms: make oneself/make oneself out to be
definition: <bawltawm> with <ki>, of oneself: make oneself into something, as unclean by what one touches, or like an angel in appearance
{a kibawltawm} before a noun: made by people, not natural
things that are made, fashioned or carved, as {lim kibawlte} carved figures

terms: can be made/can be done/can be held
definition: <kibawl>, be made or done, and <thei>, able, written as one word

terms: can be done/may be brought/can be made
definition: <kibawlthei> and <ding> written as one word: it will be possible to do it; {thu kibawltheiding} is a case can be brought, charges may be laid
<kibawl> and <theih> written as one word: that can be done, made or treated; {kibawltheih zahzah} is as much as can be done

terms: can still be made/can still be done
definition: <kibawlthei> and <lai>, still, written as one word: it is still possible to have it made

terms: keep being done/be carried on/be done onward
definition: <kibawl> in the sense be made or done with <to>, onward, written as one word: be done or made on and on, step by step
<kibawl> be made with <zawh>, finished; {a kibawlzawh}, after it was made
<kibawl>, be done or held, with <zel>, repeatedly, written as one word: of an event or operation, be held time after time

terms: be held successfully/be able to be done
definition: <kibawl>, be made or held, and <zo>, manage to, written as one word: of a meeting or task, be carried through; with a negative, cannot be done
<beel>, rely on or attach oneself to, with the passive prefix <ki>: be the one that others attach themselves to; a second use, said of houses after a disaster, is not clear
<beh> clan with <ki>, one another: belong to the same family; {a kibeh} is a relative
in {kibeh laplap}, keep being added, pile up
be added to a number or group; <tawh> names what one is added to

terms: keep increasing/be added more and more
definition: <kibehlap>, be added, with its last syllable repeated: keep being added, grow more and more in number or amount
<kibehlap>, be added, with the noun suffix {-na}: an addition to a number or group, as a new member of a household
<kibehlap> be added with the causative <sak>: add people to a group
<kibehlap> and <te> written as one word: those who are added, as a wife or husband added to a household

terms: be bewitched/be put under a spell

facing against someone, used with <tawh> and <pai>: walk contrary to, be hostile toward

terms: rush back and forth/go to and fro
definition: <kileh>, go back and forth, with <suk>, down; paired with <kilehto>

terms: rush back and forth/go to and fro
definition: <kileh>, go back and forth, with <to>, up; paired with <kilehsuk>

terms: can be bought/be available to buy

<kilei>, be bought, with <zo>, be able: used with {hi lo} for what cannot be bought at any price
tip or swing to one side as a scale does, compare <lek>: lose balance, lean now this way now that; {kilek kim} is evenly balanced

terms: let oneself be defeated/pretend to be beaten

noun from <kilemkik>: being at peace again after enmity; {gambup kilemkikna} is national reconciliation

terms: be in harmony together/agree all alike
definition: of the parts of the body all being at one with each other, where the English has have equal concern for each other

terms: be at odds/not be at peace/oppose/conflict
definition: <kilem>, be at peace, with the negative <lo>: be against someone, used with <tawh>; the English has resist

terms: not agree with/not go with/be incompatible
definition: of a food, a drink or a habit and a person or an illness, with <tawh>: the two do not suit each other, with no thought of a quarrel between people

terms: not be at peace/be at odds/quarrel

being on good terms after or instead of fighting, often as {gal kilemna}; <kilemna bawl> is make peace
<kilemna>, peace, and <bawl>, make: make peace or be reconciled; the other party stands before it with <tawh>

<kilem>, be at peace, with <sa>, already, and the ending <in>: having been put right with someone; the English has justified

<kilemsak>, reconcile, with <kik>, again; of the one who makes peace between two parties
<kilemsakkik>, reconcile, with the linking suffix <in>
<kilemsak>, reconcile, with the noun suffix <na>
<kilem>, be at peace, with the plural <te>: {gam kilemte} are lands that are at peace and feel secure

terms: be put in order/be set right/be reconciled
definition: be arranged so that the parts fit, or be put right again after going wrong

of people, leave in numbers for other places or countries, literally fly off; the dictionary data also has {kileng sak} for making something fly
<ki>, passive, with <leeng>, fly, here spelled with one e, and the causative <sak>: of an aircraft or a flight, be made to fly, be flown or run on a route
<kilen> with the linking suffix <in>; {a khut kilenin} is holding him by the hand

terms: while holding one another/hand in hand

form of <kilen> used after <khut>, hand, and before words such as <ding>: take each other by the hand, in greeting or in unity

<kilh>, nail, with <cip>, tightly; {singlamteh tungah kilhcip} is nail to the cross

<kilhcip>, nail fast, with the linking suffix <in>

<liamsak>, wound, with the prefix <ki>: with {khat leh khat}, hurt one another; of one person, be wounded

<kiliatsak>, exalt oneself, with the noun suffix <na>: thinking oneself great and looking down on others
<liau>, pay a fine, with the passive prefix <ki>: be fined; {kiliau sak} is be made to pay a fine or compensation

terms: be fined/be made to pay a fine
definition: <kiliau>, be fined, with the ending <sak>: be made to pay a sum as a penalty; the sum stands before it
<liin>, tremble, with the prefix <ki>; of a reed moving in the water
<liing>, tremble, with the prefix <ki>: shake or be shaken, of the earth, mountains, the powers of heaven or the heart
<kiliing>, shake, with the causative <sak>

<likkhia>, roll away, with the passive prefix <ki>: of the stone rolled off from the opening of the tomb

<kilukham> with the causative <sak> and the linking suffix <in>

<lunggimsak>, make heavy in heart, with the reflexive prefix <ki>

terms: please one another/satisfy oneself/be made content

<lungnemsak>, make gentle or lowly in heart, with the passive prefix <ki>: be brought low, where the English has in his humiliation
<ki> and <lungneu> written as one word: be discouraged; {kilungneu sak} is let oneself be discouraged
<lungneu>, be downhearted, with the prefix <ki> and the causative <sak>: let oneself feel small and discouraged

terms: be glad with one another/be on good terms

terms: comfort oneself/set one's mind at ease
definition: <lungnuamsak>, make glad or at ease, with the reflexive prefix <ki>
found in {kilungsim neihna}, holding something in the heart against one another, where the English has malice
<lungso>, be hot in heart, with the reflexive prefix <ki>: work oneself into anger or worry; found in {kilungso tawmsak}, make oneself fret

form of <kilungtuak>, be of one mind, used before <lohna> and <na>: {kilungtuah lohna} is disagreement and {kilungtuah na} is unity
<lung>, mind, and <tuak>, agree, with the reciprocal prefix <ki>: be of the same mind with one another to do something, here to do wrong

passive of <lup>, here lay down: of a thing, be laid or set in a place, as the pot of beer set at the gate at <Khuado>

terms: be let in/be admitted/be welcomed in

placed after a number, an amount or a clock time to show that it is an estimate, as {inn 200 kim}, about 200 houses; not the area around a place and not every

Boast about oneself or about what is still to come; compare <kisialh>, boast.
Divorce, a spelling of <kimakna> with a long vowel; {kimaakna lai} is a certificate of divorce.

<kim> in its meaning of all or every, with the place marker <ah>, after a noun: in every one of them, as {pawlpi kimah}, in every church, not around one place

terms: be on familiar terms/feel at ease together

<maitai>, cheerful, with the prefix <ki>: be bright and cheerful toward one another, or with {nang leh nang} keep oneself cheerful

terms: cheer oneself up/put on a cheerful face
definition: {Maitaisak}, make cheerful, with the reflexive prefix <ki>: make one’s own face bright, put on a smile.

terms: face each other/meet face to face/confront

terms: facing each other/face to face/opposite each other

<la>, donkey, written with a capital at the start of a line; {la khaguh} is the jawbone of a donkey
<la>, song, and <dawng>, here not answer but a counting word for songs: one song as a piece that is counted; a number follows, as in {la dawng 400}, 400 songs

{la ing}, the verb <la> with the first person ending <ing>, written short with an apostrophe as is done in songs, where the count of words is fixed; the page gives {la ing e} and {la'ng e} as the same
son of Shelah and grandson of Judah, founder of Mareshah

son of Shelah and grandson of Judah, founder of Mareshah

placed after a verb: still, yet, for the time being; the spelling with a long vowel, used by some writers, of the word more often written with a single vowel. The dictionary data also has {laai} for navel, which the articles do not show

bring out into the open what was hidden

move the body to music, in joy or to entertain
be carried on the surface of water
a dance as a thing performed or shown, the noun beside the verb {laam}; {ngeina laam} is a traditional dance and {laam lak} is to present a dance
a measure of length, the span of two outstretched arms, about six feet, counted as {laam khat}, one fathom, beside <tong>, the cubit
<laam>, dance, and <bang>, like, written as one word; poetic, in {laambang paak}, to dance and rejoice
<laam> with the linking ending <in>: dancing; in 1 Samuel 10 it renders prophesying in ecstasy
<laam>, dance, said twice and written as one word: dance on and on, dance for joy
<laam>, dance, with the noun suffix <na>: dancing, a dance
the noun <laamna>, dancing, written with a capital at the start of a sentence
<laam>, dance, with the ending {-pih}, together with: dance with someone
<laam> dance with <sa-in>, while doing
<laam> float with the causative <sak>
of God, lift a person up or raise him to honour; meaning taken from two sentences only
<laam> dance, with the plural <te>; {a laamte}, the ones who are dancing
<laam>, fathom, and <thum>, three, written as one word: three fathoms
lift something up, as the hands in prayer or a staff; also lift a person out of trouble, and of water, bear a boat upward
<laam> float with <to>, upward, and the causative <sak>
a village near Tedim in Chin State, whose dialect is close to the common Tedim speech
be found or talked of everywhere, said of a disease, crime, a saying or a party; often with <mahmah>, very
name of a share of the meat at a funeral, ending in <sa>, meat; under this heading the page says that one strip of leg meat is given to the drummer; the first part is not explained
<laa> donkey with <no>, young or small; in the verse a wild donkey in heat
<laa>, song, and <sa>, sing, written as one word: a person who sings, and also the singing of songs, as in worship
<laa> with plural <te>; {gamlak laate} is wild donkeys
a room or building where scientific or medical tests are done
brother of Rebekah and father of Leah and Rachel, for whom Jacob worked in Haran
mountain range and region north of Israel, famous for its cedar trees
the printed paper on a bottle or package that tells what is inside
a place where samples are tested or scientific work is done
<la>, song, with the second part of <laibu>, book: a book of songs or hymns
island and federal territory of Malaysia off the coast of Borneo
<labu>, song book, with <pi>, great: the large or complete book of songs, also the title of a Zomi song book; said of a person who knows very many songs
<labu>, songbook, with the plural <te>

terms: song sheet/sheet of music/copy of a song
definition: <la>, song, with <dal.3>, sheet: a song written or printed on a single sheet
name of two men: a Levite of the clan of Gershon, and an Ephraimite ancestor of Joshua
<la> and <dem> written as one word: compete with others in singing, a song competition
<la>, here the verb take, and the future marker <ding> written as one word: will take, is to take; {tavuan lading} is will take the responsibility
a Levite, father of Eliasaph the leader of the Gershonites
form of <lak>, show, used before <ding>, <nading>, <theih> and nouns: let someone see a thing, or make a quality such as power or kindness known
emphatic particle after a noun or verb that sets one fact beside another: indeed, as for, and yet
the particle <lah.2>, and yet, with <hilo>, is not: placed after a noun or clause to deny it beside another, is not that either; said twice, {A lah hilo, B lah hilo}, it means neither A nor B

{lah ing}, the verb <lah> with the first person ending <ing>, written short with an apostrophe as is done in songs, where the count of words is fixed; the page gives {lah ing e} and {lah'ng e} as the same
a man of Judah, son of Jahath, of the clans of the Zorathites
<lah> and <ding> written as one word: to be shown, something to show
form of <lakkhia> used before <loh>, <ding>, <nading> and nouns: show openly, make known, bring a person out before others
<lahkhiat>, show openly, with the noun suffix {-na}: the act of showing or making something known, a display or presentation of it
grammar term: pointing out, demonstrative, as in <lahkhiatna mintaang>, demonstrative pronoun
an adjective that points out which one is meant and answers the question <koi>, which, as <hih>, <hihte>, <hua>, <huate>, <tua> and <tuate>
grammar term: a pronoun that points at and shows a thing, as <hih>, <hihte>, <hua>, <huate>; <lahkhiatna> is showing
a pointing word that stands before a noun, as <hih> in {hih laibu hoih mahmah hi}, this book is very good
<lah> show with <kholh>, beforehand, and the noun suffix <na>; {lim lahkholhna} is a shadow or picture shown in advance
<lah> show with <kim>, every part, and the noun suffix <na>; {lahkimna lim} is a sketch that shows every detail
<lah>, show, and <kul>, must, written as one word: it is necessary to show a document or proof
town in the western lowland of Judah, listed with Kabbon and Kitlish
town in the western lowland of Judah, listed with Kabbon and Kitlish; another spelling of <Lahmam>
brother of Goliath the Gittite, killed by Elhanan son of Jair
<lah>, show, with the noun suffix <na>: the act of showing or making known, or the thing that shows it; {lim lahna} is the showing of a sign
<lahna>, showing, with the marker <ah> written after a hyphen: in showing a thing; {awsang lahna-ah} is for showing a high tone
<lahna> showing with the plural <te>, the things someone has shown; {lam lahnate} are guideposts
<lah>, show, and <nop>, want, written as one word in a dependent clause: wish to show or make known a thing or a feeling
the person to whom one wants to show something; <lah> show, with <nop> want and <mi> person
what something is meant to show or stand for; <lah> show, with <nop> want and the noun suffix <na>
a wild stinging or thorny plant that overgrows ruins, named together with <thangling>, thistle
<la>, song, and <hoih>, good, written as one word; the pair {thuhoih lahoih}, good words and good songs, stands for wholesome things to hear
<lahoih>, good song, with the plural <te>
a large city in the Punjab province of Pakistan
<lah>, show, with <sa> for a completed action: have shown; before a noun, that which was shown
<lah>, show, with <san>, toward: hold up the fist against someone
<lahsa> shown, with the plural <te>
<lah> show with the plural <te>, making a noun, the things that someone shows; {nalamdang lahte} are the signs shown
<lah>, show, with <tel>, clearly: make something plain or prove it; {lahtel nading} is evidence or proof
<lahtel>, show clearly, with <na> and plural <te>: things set out plainly
<lah>, show, with <theih>, be able; {lahtheih nadingin} means so that one may show
<lahtheih>, be able to show, and <ding> written as one word: that one can show, said of a document, permit or proof
a people of Shan State in Myanmar and of neighbouring countries

the Burmese short name of the immigration department, used for immigration officials and their camps; among Zomi refugees in Malaysia also for the officers of the United States DHS who interview for resettlement
written words, a document or anything set down in writing
a written message sent to someone
placed after a verb, before <hi> or <uh>: the state or action goes on, still; {om lai} is there is still, remains
the time when something was so, after <tua> or <hun> and before <in> or <mahin>: {tua lai in} is at that time
the middle of a place, as in {lamka lai-a}, in the middle of the crossroads; compare <laizang>
<lai>, writing, with a capital in {Lai Siangtho}, Holy Scripture, the Bible
the marks that order written text, such as <comma> and <fullstop>; the book gives the English word punctuation for it

terms: as far back as/long ago/already back when
definition: <lai.4>, the time when, and <pekin>, long ago: after a year, a number of years or a clause, already at that time long ago, as far back as; it says that something began or was so that early

terms: may it go on/may it continue
definition: <lai>, still, yet, and <tahen>, may it be: ends a wish or blessing that something go on, placed after a verb, often after <semsem>, more and more, as in {Topa'n hong zang semsem lai tahen}, may the Lord go on using you more and more
<lai>, middle, with the place marker <a>; {lamka lai-a} is in the middle of the crossroads
<lai>, the spot or point, with the place marker <ah>: {hih lai-ah} is here, at this place, and {koi lai-ah} is where, at which place
<lai>, writing, with <aw>, voice: a letter that stands for a vowel, also called <awsuaksak>
literally two vowel letters, one sound: two vowels written together and spoken as a single sound, as {-ia} and {-ua}
<lai>, letter, with <ip>, bag: the cover in which a letter is sent, on which the address is written; given by the book as a noun joined to a noun
the address of the writer or of the receiver, written at the top of a letter; the sample letter has the school and the town there
a stringed instrument, named beside harp and <laiza>; probably the English word lyre

terms: at the time of/in the days of/during
definition: {laia}, written in lower case, is <lai>, time, with the linking <a>: of or at the time named before it, as {tua hun laia}, of that time, and {nidang laia}, of former days; not the instrument
<lai> place with the place marker <ah>, in {tua laiah}, there; more often written <lai-ah>
<lai>, writing, and <at>, write, written as one word: the act of writing, or what someone has written; {laiat pa} is the writer

terms: make a will/draw up a document
definition: <lai>, writing, with <bawl>, make; {a laibawl pa} is the man who made the will
<laibawl>, draw up a document, with the ending <na>: an agreement set down in writing; {kilemna laibawlna} is a peace agreement and {thukimna laibawlna} a memorandum of understanding
<lai>, writing or letter, and <bek>, only, written as one word
a book or scroll that holds writing
a written account or register of people and events
book, capitalised as part of the title of a named book
<laibu>, book, with <pi>, big, written as one word: a large book, also the main book in which records are kept
<laibu>, book, with <saal>, storehouse, written as one word: a library; also used as the title of a collection of writings
plural of <laibu>: books or scrolls
a sheet or surface to write on; a scroll when it is rolled up
an official paper that shows who a person is or what is granted, as {UN laidal}, the refugee document of the UNHCR, and {appointment laidal}; not a blank sheet to write on

<laidal>, an official document, and <tawi>, hold: a person who holds such a document, most often {UN laidal tawi} or {UNHCR laidal tawi}, a refugee registered with the UNHCR and holding its card; it stands after the name of the document, in lists of detained persons after the person's name, and takes <te> for the plural
<laidal> and <neu> written as one word: a small sheet of paper or card with something written on it
<laidal>, sheet of writing, with the ending {-no}, small: a small written sheet, such as a short note or letter, a receipt slip or a religious tract
<laidal>, sheet, with <pi>, big: a full sheet of paper; in the news the paper letter that a refugee holds instead of a card
plural of <laidal>; {savun laidalte} are sheets of skin, parchments
<lai>, still, and <dep>, indeed, written as one word after the verb and before <hi> or {uh hi}: still doing so, and that is notable
<lai>, here still, and <diam> written as one word at the end of a question: will it still be so, I wonder whether it will yet
<lai>, here still, and <ding>, the marker of what is to come, written as one word after a verb: will still, is yet to, will go on; with <maw> or <hiam> it asks whether something is to go on
<laiding>, will still, and the sentence-final <hi> written as one word after a verb or a describing word
strike or knock about with force; <gawp> marks violent or thorough action
<lai> writing and <gelh> write as one word; {laigelh nading} is something to write with
the verb used as a noun: the act of writing, or what someone has written, as in {ka laigelh}, my writing; the same as <laigelhna>
<lai>, writing, and <gelhkhiat>, write out, written as one word: what someone writes and puts out, as a post on social media
the act of writing or the thing written
the tool for writing carried by a scribe
<laigelhna>, a writing, with the plural <te>: written works, as the writings of the prophets
<laigelh>, write, with <pa> for a man: the man who wrote a text; a writer also uses it of himself, the present writer
<lai> and <gelhsak> written as one word: have a letter written for oneself by someone else, here by an office
<laigelh>, write, and <siam>, skilled, written as one word: a person skilled at writing, an author
<laigelh>, writer, with the plural <te>: people whose work is writing, such as secretaries and scribes
<laigelh> with the plural <te>: things that someone has written, such as letters, dispatches and the writings of the prophets
<laigelh>, writing, and <zia>, way, written as one word: how a person writes, the conventions followed in writing
the rules of how a language is written, its orthography
the innermost and most important part of something; <thu laigil> is the heart of a matter
<laigil>, core, with the plural <te>: the central and most important parts of a matter; {Pasian thu laigilte} is the heart of the word of God
<lai>, writing, with <gual>, row: a line of written text, a sentence
<laigual>, sentence, with <picing>, full-grown: a sentence that is complete in itself; two of them may be joined by <ngaklang>, the semicolon
<laigual>, sentence, with the ending {-a}: {laiguala zatna} is the use of a word in sentences
<laigual>, sentence, with the marker <in> of the doer
plural of <laigual>: the lines or sentences of a piece of writing
the cord that joins a child to its mother before birth; {laigui zoppihte}, those joined by the same cord, are children of the same mother
<laigui>, umbilical cord, and <zom>, join, written as one word: brothers and sisters born of the same mother, siblings by blood; often after <sanggam> or <unau>
plural of <laiguizom>: brothers and sisters born of the same mother
take the place or office of another, or put one thing in place of another; {galvil laih} is change the guard
<lai>, writing or study, and <hanciam>, strive, written as one word: make an effort in one's studies
in the middle between high and low or large and small; {mi laihawl} is the middle class and {sumlut laihawl gam} a middle-income country
a paper or magazine given out at regular times, from <lai>, writing, and <hawm>, distribute
plural of <laihawm>: papers and magazines that are given out regularly
<laih>, replace or change, and the future marker <ding> written as one word: will change, in order to change
<laihding> and <bek>, only, written as one word: for nothing more than changing it
<lai>, still, and the sentence ending <hi> written as one word after a verb or describing word: it is still so, it can still be done
<lai>, still, and the question word <hiam> written as one word after a verb or describing word: is it still so, whether it is still so
<lai>, writing, with <hilh>, teach: one who teaches, or the work of teaching; {laihilh za} is the office of teacher
used as a verb, teach in a school or class, with <ding>, <dingin> or the sentence ending <hi> after it; the noun sense names the teacher or the work
<laihilh>, teach, with the noun suffix <na>: teaching; {laihilhna sanginn} is a school or lecture hall
<laihilh>, teach, and <sia>, teacher, written as one word: a person whose work is teaching, in a school, a university or at home
<laihilh>, teacher, with the plural <te>: those who teach in the church
<laihilh>, teaching, and <zia>, way, written as one word: the way of teaching in school
<laih> replace, with the linking suffix <in>: taking the place or office of another
<laih>, replace, with <khia>, out: take someone out of an office and put another in, or change a thing for another
<laih>, replace or exchange, with <kik>, again or back, written as one word: change something again, or change it back to what it was

<laih> and <lo> written as one word: not changing, without replacing
noun from <laih>: putting one thing in place of another, as changing a phone number, replacing old aircraft or amending a law
<laih>, replace, and <nading>, in order to, written as one word: for replacing the thing named before it
<laih>, replace, with <nuam>, want: wish to put one thing in place of another, as changing the gospel for another message
<laih>, replace, and <pah>, at once, written as one word
exclamation of sudden surprise or dismay, said with <a> or <ka> before it, as <alaihsaih> and {Ka laihsaih}; the book lists it among the interjections
<laih>, exchange, with the causative <sak>: change one thing for another, or change it for someone, as clothes, a name or a number
<laihsak>, change one thing for another, with the linking <in>, written as one word: changing it and then
<laih> and <sawm>, intend, written as one word: set out to change one thing for another

terms: can be changed/be replaceable/able to change

<laihuan>, examination, with the noun ending {-na}: an examination, the sitting of an examination
name of the second, middle note of the three notes of the gongs, <daak>, the note r of sol-fa, between <un> and <eu>
<lai> in its sense of a period of time and <in> written as one word, placed after a verb or a word of time: while, at the time when; {tua hun laiin} is at that time
a written message sent to someone; {laikhak sim} is read a letter
<lai>, letter, with <khak>, send: send a letter to someone; more often written as two words, {lai khak}
<laikhak>, letter, with <gelhzia>, way of writing: the form in which a letter is set out; the book names two kinds, to family and friends and to an office
<laikhak>, send a letter, with the noun suffix <na>: the letter sent or the sending of it

terms: have a letter sent/send a letter
definition: <lai>, letter, <khak>, send, and the causative <sak> written as one word: send a letter or have one sent to someone
<laikhak>, letter, with the plural <te>: written messages sent to someone; {laikhakte gelh} is write letters

terms: a letter/a note/a piece of writing
definition: <lai> and <khat> written as one word: one letter, note or written message
<lai>, writing, and <khetna>, printing, written as one word: the printing of books and papers; {laikhetna set} is a printing press
pull a building apart and clear it away; built with <khia>, out
a bed, the place where one lies, in songs and elevated language; the everyday word is <lupna>

terms: be given a paper/be issued a document
definition: <lai> and <kipia> written as one word: be given a letter or written permit
a tool for writing or for marking a line; {sik laikung} is an iron pen
<laikung>, pen, and <laidal>, sheet of paper, set side by side: pens and paper, the writing materials a pupil or an office needs; {laikung laidal man} is the cost of stationery
the same pair used of official papers: the documents that allow a person to stay or that an office issues, after <phalna>, permit, or the name of the office
<laikung>, pen, with the subject marker <in> written as one word
placed after a verb: keep on doing, still do in spite of something
<lailai>, still, with the noun-forming ending <na>, placed after a verb: the going on doing it, as in {gen ngam lailaina}, daring to keep on speaking
<lai> and <lam> written as one word: the field of writing, books and learning; {lailam nasep} is literary work
<lai>, here still, and <leh>, here if, written as one word after a verb: if one still does it, if it goes on

terms: if we also/if we go on to
definition: <lai>, here still or further, and <leng>, if, written as one word after a verb: if we do this as well, if we go on doing it; the result follows
the marks that divide and mark off sentences and phrases in writing, punctuation; the lesson lists twelve of them, from <husanna>, comma, to <umtuam>, bracket; also written <lai lepna>

<lai>, writing, with <let> in the sense of turning into another language: translate a text; placed at the end of an article before the name of the translator, as {lai at} is placed before the name of the writer
village near Tedim in Chin State; written in brackets after a personal name it tells the home village
cave and old settlement where one group of the people lived before it spread to the Falam, Khalkha, Matupi and Thantlang areas
the middle or inmost part of a thing or of a person, the heart or mind; {ka lailung ah} is in my heart
<lai>, writing, with <mai>, face: one side of a leaf of a book
<lai>, writing, with <mal>, a single item: a written letter or word, or what is written
<laimal>, letter, with <bulpi>, main or basic: the basic letters of the writing, the alphabet; the book heads the lesson {Laimal bulpite} and glosses it alphabets
<laimal>, letter, with <gawmzia>, way of joining: how the letters of a word are put together; words that sound different may have the same spelling
<laimal>, letter, with <gol>, big: a capital letter, one of the two kinds of letters of Zolai beside <laimal neu>
<laimal>, letter, with <neu>, small: a small letter, one of the two kinds of letters of Zolai beside <laimal gol>
<laimal>, written letter, with <gawm>, join: the way the letters of a word are put together, spelling
<laimal>, letter, with <gol>, big: the capital letter with which a sentence begins
<laimal> written letter, with the marker <in> showing means
<laimal>, letter, with {-pi}, big: a capital letter
<laimalpi>, capital letter, with the plural <te>
<laimal>, written letter, with the plural <te>
<lai>, still, and <mawk>, a word of surprise or emphasis, written as one word after a verb: still, even now, and more than one would expect
the Lai people of the Hakha and Falam areas of Chin State, one of the names used among the Chin peoples beside Zomi and Mizo
a place or spot, also a place in a text or talk; {hih laimun ah} is at this place, at this point

a letter that cannot sound by itself and is joined to a vowel to make a word; the book counts B C D F G H J K L M N P Q R S T V W X Y Z and Ng, Kh, Ph, Th, and says F J Q R X Y are little used in Zolai
<la>, take, and <in> written as one word: taking, or as a request with <hong>, come and take
<lai>, still, with the noun-forming ending <na>, placed after a verb, the being still so, as in {a om laina}, those still remaining, {a nuntak laina}, their living on
feel pain within for someone; {nang’ lainat nading} is something for you to be troubled about
<lainat>, feel compassion, with the noun suffix <na>: tender feeling or concern for someone
<lainat>, feel pity, with the suffix <pih>: feel sorrow together with someone who suffers or mourns; {ki lainatpih} is said in messages of condolence
<lainat>, feel compassion, with <pih>, together with, and the noun suffix <na>: feeling the pain of someone together with them; {lainatpihna lahna} is a showing of condolence to the bereaved
the soft inner part of a stem or trunk, and so the core or essential part of a matter
written letters or a written text; {laipai khat zong} with a negative is not even a single letter, of one who cannot read or of something done without any writing
<lai>, writing, with <pau>, speech: the written form of a language, in which words such as {kei in} are written out, as opposed to <kampau>, the spoken form
in {khanglui laipek panin}, from the days of old; the exact sense of {laipek} alone is not clear from the verse
<lai>, time, and <pekin>, long ago, written as one word after a describing word: back in the time when it was so
<lai>, a letter or piece of writing, and the topic marker <pen> written as one word: the letter, this writing, as the thing spoken about
a written paper handed in or laid before someone, such as a letter of support or the papers of a case; used by one writer
a tall water plant that grows in marshes; {laiphai kungte} are papyrus plants
<lai> and <phi> written as one word: sit a school examination; {tan 10 laiphi} is to sit the tenth standard examination

terms: still for now/for the time being
definition: <lai>, still, and <phot>, for the time being, written as one word after a verb: the action goes on for now
<lai>, time or midst, with the intensifier <pi>, usually followed by <mahin>: at the very time when, right in the midst of; {sunkim laipi} is high noon or broad daylight

<lai>, writing, with <pi>, great: a formal paper given or sent, named by the word before it, as <pahtawina laipi>, a certificate of honour, {ngetna laipi}, an application, {sapna laipi}, an invitation; not the conjunction {laipi}, while still
the religion founded by Pau Cin Hau and the script he made, {Laipian Lai}; also said of its followers and their church
<lai>, letters, with <pil>, wise: learned from books, doing well at school; also a person who is so, as in {laipil khat}
<lai>, letters, and <pilna>, knowledge, written as one word: learning gained from books and school
<lai>, letter, and <puak>, send or deliver, written as one word: a letter that is sent or brought to someone; also the act of delivering it
